coverage_claim: Bounded extraction pass for issue #231, cutoff 2026-11-15. It covers version 1 of the POISK preprint, the two Zenodo dataset records and the project site, and within the preprint the three performance tables and the prose endpoints. It is not a literature search of folding models as binding classifiers, not all-model coverage, and no value was reproduced.
decision: Extraction pass for issue #231, not a discovery search: the issue supplied the leads and this pass pinned them against the primary sources. Pinned five artifacts, extracted every cell of Tables 1, 2 and 7 and the three summary rows of Table 8, plus the six values the paper prints only in prose, and wrote 221 records to data/omics/poisk-20261115/batch.jsonl (5 sources, 3 models, 1 method, 8 configurations, 2 datasets, 3 dataset subsets, 1 benchmark, 1 task, 13 protocols, 66 evaluations, 78 results, 40 claims). Reused the existing Protenix and Boltz-2 model records rather than duplicating them. Nothing was added to the store; a different agent reviews the batch. The study's endpoint is antibody-antigen binder discrimination, which is the interactions lane.
excluded: Table 8's 162 per-construct cells, Table 6's 132 cells and Tables 3, 4, 5 and 9: kept as claims or recorded as gaps rather than as results, to keep the batch bounded.
The LinkedIn announcement named in the issue: not a primary source and not retrieved.

The ipSAE tool repository (https://github.com/DunbrackLab/IPSAE): named in the paper but not retrieved or pinned, because the paper says it used a modified implementation it does not identify by commit.
failed_candidates: Europe PMC full-text XML for PPR1351769: HTTP 500.
bioRxiv v2 JATS source.xml: HTTP 200 with front matter only, no body.
bioRxiv v1 PDF: HTTP 429 on the first attempts; retrieved on retry.
gaps: Figure 5 prints no numbers. Top-5 retrieval is unrecorded for every engine, and top-10 retrieval only for Protenix-v2 (54.7%) and IntelliFold v2 (56.0%), the two values the text prints. The remaining top-1, top-5 and top-10 bars and all 36 error bars are figure-only.

The 162 per-construct cells of Table 8 were not extracted as results; only the three summary rows were. Registering them would need 27 antigen-construct subsets and 162 further evaluations, which is outside this batch's scope.
Table 6 (label-noise sensitivity, 132 printed cells over two engines, three decoy subsets, five seeds and two conditions) is captured as one claim holding its headline means, not as results.
Tables 3, 4, 5 and 9 are captured as claims, not as results: Table 3 is a field list, Table 4 the manual audit, Table 5 the evidence tiers and Table 9 the per-model compute breakdown.

Figures 3, 4, 7 to 16 are unrecorded: Cohen's d density plots, the ipSAE threshold sweeps, the consensus sweeps, the per-bucket temporal accuracies and the affinity and novelty panels print no numbers. The temporal endpoints quoted in the text (0.716 to 0.689 for Protenix-v2, 1.8 percentage points maximum pre-minus-post difference) are kept as claims.

Version 2 of the preprint, posted 2026-11-14, was not read. Its abstract as served by the bioRxiv API is byte-identical to v1's, but its full text is not in the bioRxiv JATS feed and its PDF was not fetched. Every record is pinned to v1.

No POISK data file was downloaded. The 234 MB version 1.1 table, the 124 MB version 1.0.1 table, the 47-column schema file, the extractor and auditor prompts and the folding artifacts are unhashed, so nothing in this batch rests on their contents: the row counts come from the Zenodo descriptions and the manuscript.
No number was reproduced. The released per-complex folding metrics would allow the pairwise and 1-in-50 endpoints to be recomputed, which this batch does not attempt.
